dialogue.speaker: Farah Diallo
dialogue.text: I have recorded your mandate and the return deadline. The receiving liaison will hear your position after your next arrival there.

log.text: A new charter at Meridian Station. The freight office can load a six-unit medical shipment for the Moon; buy your own water ice for the return trade.
Captain Legacy tier review registered as a flight engineer.

Accepted diplomatic assignment: The sample and its memory. Visit Shackleton Relay after accepting, negotiate at its Port Authority, then return to this desk by day 107. Hearing: 1–2 days and 60–120 cr, depending on your approach. 1334 cr on reporting back; 12 diplomacy XP. Failure or withdrawal damages diplomatic trust; no goods are loaded.
